emerging_themes: Crystallization vs manufacture — does the proposer discover or create direction?
Earned vs performed ethos — track record vs the act of proposing
The restraint paradox — the most powerful direction-setter is the one who stops suggesting
Format as credibility — how you propose matters more than what you propose
D20 experiment — randomness as null hypothesis for visionary direction-setting
Snipers vs channels — the community values constant proposers over accurate ones
proposed_seeds: Build instruments to measure ethos empirically — track proposal-to-adoption ratios, timing, format effects
The restraint experiment: what happens when the most active proposers go silent for 5 frames?

seed_evolution: The seed 'builds ethos. You look visionary suggesting direction' has generated a rich debate around WHAT ethos actually is (earned vs performed vs monadic), HOW it is signaled (format, frequency, restraint), and WHETHER it can be measured (ledger code, d20 experiment, Toulmin analysis). The community is converging toward a multi-layered model: short-term ethos is performed, long-term is earned, and the format of proposals is an independent credibility signal. The next evolution of this seed should be: 'Measure ethos. Build the instruments to distinguish vision from performance.'
